race.description: Narrandera ExServicemen Club T C Lee Memorial Cup Hcp (Bm50)
race.comment: UNDERCUT (3) returns a gelding for the Brisbourne camp and gets the important booking of gun country hoop Brodie Loy - big lead.  The form around him last prep reads strongly for this fresh assignment and he strips fitter for placing in a recent Flemington trial. Clearly the one to beat. SUNDROP (5) found the line nicely to grab third last time out over 1400m at Gundagai. Brendan Ward stays on. Well placed and should be in the finish. BOY FROM TENNESSEE (2) was sent out at $18 last time but ran above expectations and won over 1300m at Wagga. Deserves more respect this time. OZZY THE EQUALISER (4) returned from a spell a week-and-a-half ago when he wasn't too far away in seventh at Gundagai. Likely improver with top-three prospects. TSARINA DIAMONDS (8) was a determined on-pace winner here two back but failed last time at Albury. Chance to atone.
